summary: A city clerk's office tells would-be candidates that deadlines are strict and early filing leaves time to fix mistakes.
realLife: A city clerk's election page says nomination deadlines are strict and advises filing early so errors can be corrected before the cutoff, and sets pickup by appointment.
sources: City of Piedmont, City Clerk, filing deadlines for candidates (undated): https://piedmont.ca.gov/services___departments/city_clerk/elections/run-for-office/filing-deadlines
